notes.title: Game Discount + my Gamedev journey news
notes.content:
[h3]Hey all![/h3]
[h2]Just wanted to pop in to say that [b]Plastomorphosis [/b] is on the weekly discount! 30% off![/h2]

If you still happen to be on the fence, check out the game since there were a lot of fixes applied ;)  [spoiler] (especially fixed walking animation for a female playable character) [/spoiler]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459430


[hr][/hr]

[h2]And some game development news: [/h2]
my new game called [b]Snowsquall Grip[/b] is in development. 
It is a short first-person horror/thriller game about losing the mind in a sudden snowstorm.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000420

notes.title: PLASTOMORPHOSIS: UPDATED TO V1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]PLASTOMORPHOSIS Version 1.1[/h2]

[h3]Changed:[/h3]

[list]
[*] attempted to address the 'Modern controls' behavior, specifically the issue with 'looped moving in circles'. Note that the bug may persist when switching from a fixed camera to a player-following camera. I still recommend playing with 'Tank' controls for the optimal experience;
[*] added special ‘dark portals’ on the ‘Shadow Corn Fields’ levels to make backtracking easier;
[*] minor fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Added:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added support for two new languages: Simplified Chinese and Ukrainian.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Demo feedback: Dev Analysis
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/539107176eac7a2d3c792f85c1757af56b43df92.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230229/539107176eac7a2d3c792f85c1757af56b43df92.gif[/img][/url]

Hey guys, 
developer here.

I wanted to thank you for trying out the demo version of the game and providing valuable feedback.

[h3]I have made several adjustments and improvements based on your feedback, which will be available in the release version of the game. Here's a preview of some of the new features:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added 'Modern' controls: While I feel that the tank controls are more suited to the game, some players wished for an option to use modern controls. This will be particularly useful for those using a controller: Left Stick against using a D-Pad (tank controls) 
[*] Added a map: To help with navigation, was added a simple level/map layout to help you orientate the game environment. -- though it's not available for every level ;)
[*] Added map hints: This is an optional feature that shows the key positions of items, which should help with puzzle-solving.
[*]Improved puzzles: I tried to make some puzzles more user-friendly, especially the first code puzzle.
[*]Updated UI/UX: I have updated the 'Notes' screen and the UX when viewing and navigating notes.
[*]Visual options: It is now possible to decrease the pixelation effect, though it is not possible to turn it off completely due to the retro aesthetics of the game.
[*]Optimized the game: I have worked on making it run faster on low-end hardware, and I am still testing it using my integrated card (Intel UHD 630).
[*]Added other small game improvements: I have made further improvements to the game to give it a final touch.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Here are a few potential ideas I'm considering (possibly after the game's release):[/h3]
[list]

[*]Introducing a female skin for the game character. Spoiler: [spoiler] This won't affect gameplay or the storyline.[/spoiler]
[*]Implementing easy difficulty mode: Although the game isn't overly hardcore, this idea could attract a wider range of players. ?...Just a thought.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

The game is set to be released[b] at the end of January[/b], and I will keep you updated with any news. 

Stay tuned for news. Follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/vidygames]X/Twitter[/url] or follow (if you are still not) the Steam Page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459430/Plastomorphosis/


Stay safe and play indie games!
